blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Manila North Cemetery and Manila South Cemetery have released their schedules and reminders for the commemoration of Undas 2026. Many Filipinos are expected to flock to cemeteries to remember their departed loved ones during this period, particularly on November 1 and November 2. READ: Data show fires rise during Undas: How to stay safe In an advisory, the Manila North Cemetery said that from October 29, 2026 to November 2, 2026, it will be open from 5 a.m. to 8 p.m. Cleaning and painting of tombs during the Undas season will be allowed until October 27, 2026 […]...
